sentences.en: I have the draft ready, but I still need an illustrator.
sentences.zh: 我已经准备好了草稿，但还需要一位插图画家。

sentences.en: He's a terrific artist, but he's not much of an illustrator.
sentences.zh: 他是一位非常棒的艺术家，但他并不是一位出色的插图画家。

sentences.en: This book has amazing art. I wonder who the illustrator is.
sentences.zh: 这本书的艺术真是太棒了。我想知道插图画家是谁。
